name: Tidepool meets then beats its application peers
asks: we wanna list meet-then-beats for more of our apps/ basically every app

against.name: Evennia
against.domain: programmable persistent multiuser worlds and human/agent interfaces

against.name: LambdaMOO
against.domain: live programmable world interaction, object persistence and participant agency

met-when.says: The actual Tidepool world/server and human/agent clients are recovered or coherently fabricated in their own Engineering repository and canonical game-app home; the catalog record alone does not supply the missing software.
Tidepool demonstrates parity with every named target on its relevant player and author workflows, with pinned baselines, explicit coverage, comparable conditions and independent receiving evidence.
After parity with each target, Tidepool demonstrates a material improvement in useful play or authoring capability while retaining the parity capabilities.

x-provenance.target-selection-authority: You should use your own best thinking and ambitions to say what each should meet-then-beat
x-provenance.intended-capability: A rich tidal persistent-world application in which humans and agents can play, author, trade and govern through a legible protocol, with recoverable source and durable world continuity.
x-provenance.classification: recovery-required application; the authored catalog explicitly records that current world source is absent
qualification-gaps: Resolve exact versions, capability coverage, workloads, measures and independent receiving operations; no parity, superiority or signed enterprise admission is asserted.
x-provenance.source-gap: The held catalog states that world code, protocol documentation, terminal and bot clients are not present at a recorded repository path. No placeholder repository is substituted for recovery.
